title: Fourth Station: Jesus Meets His Mother
text:
Consider the meeting of the Jesus and His Mother, Mary, which took place on this journey. Jesus and Mary looked at each other, and their looks became as arrows piercing each other's hearts, which loved each other so tenderly.

My most loving Jesus, by the sorrow that Thou didst experience
in this meeting, grant me the grace of a truly devoted love for
Thy most holy mother. And thou, my Queen, who was so overwhelmed
with sorrow, obtain for me by thy intercession a most loving and
tender remembrance of the Passion of thy Son, Jesus.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will...Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
